description: This Java class `AutowiredCredentialsAdapter` is a Spring component that extends `EventBusCredentialsAdapter`. It uses dependency injection to set a `CredentialsService` implementation, providing a default event bus-based service implementation for credentials management in the Eclipse Hono device registry.

classes.name: AutowiredCredentialsAdapter
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that provides credentials services via an event bus, extending the `EventBusCredentialsAdapter` class.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Setter method annotated with `@Autowired` and `@Qualifier` to inject a `CredentialsService` bean named 'backend'.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the injected `CredentialsService` instance.
